statusLine.command: input=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id' | cut -c1-8); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model' | grep -o 'opus\|sonnet\|haiku' | head -1); transcript=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path'); user_msgs=$(grep -c 'SendUserMessage' "$transcript" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); tok_est=$((user_msgs * 8000)); tok_pct=$((tok_est * 100 / 200000)); if [ $tok_pct -gt 100 ]; then tok_pct=100; fi; exceeds=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.exceeds_200k_tokens'); if [ "$exceeds" = "true" ]; then tok_pct='100!'; fi; workdir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); git_branch=$(cd "$workdir" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'none'); mem_count=$(ls ~/.claude/projects/*/memory/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | xargs); if [ "${CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY:-1}" = "0" ]; then T='X'; else T='!'; fi; mcp_enabled=$(jq -r '.enabledPlugins | length' ~/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null); hooks=$(jq -r 'keys | map(select(endswith(\"Hook\"))) | length' ~/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null); tests=$(cd "$workdir" 2>/dev/null && [ -d test -o -d tests -o -d __tests__ ] && echo '+' || echo '-'); secrets=$(cd "$workdir" 2>/dev/null && [ -f .env -o -f secrets.json -o -f credentials.json ] && echo '!' || echo ''); echo "[$model ~${tok_pct}%][🤖:0][hook:$hoo ks][mcp:$mcp_enabled][$git_branch][test:$tests][memory:$mem_count][telem:$T][aws:${AWS_REGION}$secrets][$sid]"
